---
title: "Environment verification with synthetic data"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
---

```{r}
set.seed(42)
d <- data.frame(x = seq_len(50), noise = rnorm(50))
d$y <- 2 * d$x + d$noise
fit <- lm(y ~ x, data = d)
stopifnot(abs(coef(fit)[['x']] - 2) < 0.1)
summary(fit)
```

```{r}
plot(d$x, d$y)
abline(fit)
sessionInfo()
```
